title: Mweya Wemwoyo Murefu weImba Tsvene
intro: Mumapeji eKorani, munhu anobuda mudzinza remuporofita mukuru, akapihwa sechipo pakukwegura. Mweya uyu unorumbidzwa nekuda kwechokwadi chisingachinji uye basa guru mukuvaka nzvimbo tsvene yaizova chiedza chekutenda. Paunoverenga zviratidzo, nyatsoteerera inzwi rekare, nekuti rinotaura mumunhu wekutanga.
clues: Ndakataurwa muKorani pamwe chete nemumwe muporofita sechipo chakapihwa kumutumwa akwegura.
Ndaive mumwe wevana vaviri vakapihwa muporofita iyeye mumakore ake ekupedzisira.
Ndakatakura rukudzo rweuporofita uye ndakatumwa semutumwa.
Ndakabatana nababa vangu mukusimudzira nheyo dzeImba Tsvene.
Ndinoyeukwa semumwe wevanhu vane mwoyo murefu, uye imba tsvene yatakavaka yakava nzvimbo yekudzoka nekuchengetedzwa kwevanhu.
arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
